results.name: Dormant High-CVSS Vulnerability (No Telemetry Activity)
results.description: Vulnerability scanner flags Critical CVE (CVSS 9.8, EPSS 0.85), but zero network maliciousness detected on ingress/egress.
results.conceptual_goal: Risk moderated by empirical telemetry, mitigating alert fatigue.

results.name: Zero-Day Attack (NVD/EPSS Silent, Active Telemetry Breach)
results.description: Exploit has no public CVE or EPSS signature (P5 evaluates as low/benign), but active telemetry exhibits PortScan / DoS flood behavior.
results.conceptual_goal: Empirical network telemetry elevates risk immediately, mitigating source database lag.

results.name: Active Brute-Force Credential Attack (Corroborated Threat)
results.description: High CVSS service exposed to the internet, actively undergoing SSH/FTP-Patator attack flows.
results.conceptual_goal: Both models corroborate high risk, reinforcing high-confidence mitigation priority.

results.name: Normal High-Volume Web Operations (Legitimate Scale)
results.description: Enterprise e-commerce spike during business hours. Both static posture and network telemetry are clean.
results.conceptual_goal: Risk remains firmly low, zero false positive escalation.
